workflow.name: Plan, implement, review
workflow.description: Plan a change read-only, implement it, then review the result read-only. Linear, no commit.

prompts.label: plan
prompts.text:
Read the code and plan this change: {{variables.task}}
List the steps and the files each step touches.

prompts.label: implement
review
prompts.text: Review the working-tree diff for {{variables.task}}. Report problems by severity, most important first.

rules.message: The review is too short to be useful
